name: Window weather
summary: A building at dusk where the poster's big window shows their sky and temperature, and each friend lights a window with the sky where they are right now (sun, cloud, rain, snow or night), their temperature and place; warmest and coldest are called out.
useWhen: yo whats up just having fun in south america eating tostadas
28 degrees and sunny here, how's everyone
what's the weather like where yall are
dontUseWhen: a guessing game about where someone is (use guess-where)
planning around the forecast for an event (use clear-skies)
a trip with several stops (use souvenir-passport)

author.description: Who posted; theirs is the big window

windows.description: Friends' windows: where they are, their sky, temperature and a line
